promo_codes_window_check.name: promo_codes_window_check
promo_codes_window_check.value:
"promo_codes"."starts_at" IS NULL
        OR "promo_codes"."ends_at" IS NULL
        OR "promo_codes"."starts_at" < "promo_codes"."ends_at"

promo_codes_limits_check.name: promo_codes_limits_check
promo_codes_limits_check.value:
("promo_codes"."max_uses" IS NULL OR "promo_codes"."max_uses" > 0)
        AND ("promo_codes"."max_uses_per_user" IS NULL OR "promo_codes"."max_uses_per_user" > 0)

refunds_confirmation_check.name: refunds_confirmation_check
refunds_confirmation_check.value:
("refunds"."status" != 'refunded' OR "refunds"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("refunds"."status" != 'refund_failed' OR "refunds"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL)

users_telegram_user_id_digits_check.name: users_telegram_user_id_digits_check
users_telegram_user_id_digits_check.value:
length("users"."telegram_user_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 20
        AND "users"."telegram_user_id" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'

users_optional_fields_length_check.name: users_optional_fields_length_check
users_optional_fields_length_check.value:
("users"."last_name" IS NULL OR length("users"."last_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 64)
        AND ("users"."username" IS NULL OR length("users"."username") BETWEEN 1 AND 32)
        AND ("users"."language_code" IS NULL OR length("users"."language_code") BETWEEN 2 AND 16)
        AND ("users"."photo_url" IS NULL OR length("users"."photo_url") <= 2048)
